notes.title: Destiny Star Girlfriend 2 Coming to Steam
notes.content:
Destiny Star Girlfriend 2 is coming to Steam!
Wishlist now ➡
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361740/Destiny_Star_Girlfriend_2/

ABOUT THIS GAME
Seiji’s “tied by fate” again, this time with a magical girl one year his senior! In part 2 of this rowdy rom-com VN series, a freak faceoff sees Seiji become Maja’s familiar—and bound by an enchanted tether to survive. Will proximity lead to love, or is he doomed to serve till the end of (his) days?

 Localized for Steam based on the 2019 Android release
 Multi-choice, single-ending VN with 10+ hours till credits
 Award-winning “Destiny Star Girlfriend” second installment
 Spacey visual effects, CG artwork, and anime-style sprites
 Star-studded cast of professional Japanese voice talent
